title: Mobile Service & Device Installment Plan · 24-month term
costAssumption: Assuming you keep AutoPay and paperless billing, and stay for the full 24 months.
verdict: The price goes up after a year, and leaving early is expensive.
questions: Can Nimbus Mobile guarantee the $35 monthly plan price for the full 24 months of the contract?
What is the current standard rate for Nimbus Unlimited Plus if I do not use AutoPay or paperless billing?
Has the Administrative & Regulatory Cost Recovery Fee changed in the last year, and are there any planned increases?
What is the exact total cost to cancel service in month 18, including the remaining device balance?

letter.subject: Request to amend Service Agreement - Guaranteed Plan Price
letter.body:
To Nimbus Mobile Customer Service,

I am writing to request an amendment to the Service Agreement for the Nimbus Unlimited Plus plan and Pixelon 9 Pro device.

Specifically, I would like to request that the monthly plan price of $35.00 be guaranteed for the entire 24-month term of the agreement, rather than increasing to the then-current standard rate in month 13.

Please let me know if this amendment is possible and how to proceed.

Sincerely,
[Your name]
[Your address]
[Date]
[Member/Account number]

text:
NIMBUS MOBILE — SERVICE AGREEMENT & DEVICE INSTALLMENT PLAN
Plan: Nimbus Unlimited Plus   Device: Pixelon 9 Pro (256 GB)

SUMMARY OF CHARGES
Plan price: $35.00/month*   Device: $0 down, $27.50/month for 24 months
*With AutoPay and paperless billing. Promotional price.

1. PLAN PRICE. Your plan price is $35.00 per month for the first twelve (12) months ("Promotional Period"). Starting in month 13, your plan price will be the then-current standard rate for Nimbus Unlimited Plus, currently $50.00 per month.

2. AUTOPAY DISCOUNT. The plan price includes a $5.00 monthly AutoPay discount. If AutoPay is turned off or you choose paper billing, the discount ends and your monthly price increases by $5.00.

3. ONE-TIME CHARGES. A one-time activation fee of $35.00 will appear on your first bill.

4. ADMINISTRATIVE AND REGULATORY FEE. A monthly Administrative & Regulatory Cost Recovery Fee of $3.49 per line will be added to your bill. This fee is not a tax or government-required charge and may change.

5. DEVICE INSTALLMENT PLAN. You agree to pay the device price of $660.00 in 24 equal monthly installments of $27.50. There is no interest.

6. TERM AND EARLY CANCELLATION. This agreement has a 24-month term. If you cancel service before the end of the term, (a) the remaining device balance becomes due immediately, and (b) if you cancel within the first twelve (12) months, an early termination fee of $200.00 applies.

7. DATA. Unlimited Plus includes unlimited data. After 40 GB of data use in a billing cycle, Nimbus may slow your data speeds during times of network congestion. Video streams at up to 480p.

8. CHANGES TO TERMS. Nimbus may change prices, fees, and features of your plan with thirty (30) days' notice. If a change increases your monthly plan price, you may cancel without paying the early termination fee, but the remaining device balance still becomes due.

9. RETURN POLICY. You may cancel and return the device in like-new condition within fourteen (14) days of purchase for a full refund of the device price and plan charges, less usage charges.

10. ARBITRATION. You and Nimbus agree to resolve disputes through binding individual arbitration instead of in court, except for small-claims matters.

Customer Signature: ____________________   Date: __________

clauses.quote: Your plan price is $35.00 per month for the first twelve (12) months ("Promotional Period"). Starting in month 13, your plan price will be the then-current standard rate for Nimbus Unlimited Plus, currently $50.00 per month.
clauses.title: Price increases after 12 months
clauses.meaning: Your monthly plan cost will go up from $35 to $50 after the first year.
clauses.whyItMatters: You are locked into a 24-month contract, but the advertised price only lasts for half of it. Your monthly bill will increase by $15 for the second year.
clauses.whatToDo: Ask if Nimbus Mobile will guarantee the $35 price for the full 24 months. If not, factor the higher price into your budget.

clauses.quote: The plan price includes a $5.00 monthly AutoPay discount. If AutoPay is turned off or you choose paper billing, the discount ends and your monthly price increases by $5.00.
clauses.title: AutoPay discount is conditional
clauses.meaning: The $35 monthly price assumes you use AutoPay and paperless billing. If you stop either, your bill goes up by $5 per month.
clauses.whyItMatters: If you prefer to pay manually or receive paper bills, your monthly cost will be $40 for the first year and $55 for the second year.
clauses.whatToDo: Decide if you are comfortable with AutoPay and paperless billing. If not, add $5 to your expected monthly cost.

clauses.quote: A monthly Administrative & Regulatory Cost Recovery Fee of $3.49 per line will be added to your bill. This fee is not a tax or government-required charge and may change.
clauses.title: Admin fee can change
clauses.meaning: You pay an extra $3.49 each month for an administrative fee. Nimbus Mobile can change this amount at any time.
clauses.whyItMatters: This fee is not fixed. Nimbus Mobile can increase it, adding to your monthly cost beyond the plan price increase.
clauses.whatToDo: Ask Nimbus Mobile if they have increased this fee recently or plan to do so. Understand that it is an unpredictable cost.

clauses.quote: This agreement has a 24-month term. If you cancel service before the end of the term, (a) the remaining device balance becomes due immediately, and (b) if you cancel within the first twelve (12) months, an early termination fee of $200.00 applies.
clauses.title: Expensive to cancel early
clauses.meaning: If you end your service before 24 months, you must pay for the rest of your phone immediately. If you cancel in the first 12 months, you also pay an extra $200 fee.
clauses.whyItMatters: Leaving early means paying the full remaining $27.50 monthly device payments at once. If you leave in month 6, you owe $200 plus 18 months of device payments ($495), totaling $695.
clauses.whatToDo: Be sure you want to commit to Nimbus Mobile for 24 months. Calculate the cost of leaving early before you sign.

clauses.quote: Nimbus may change prices, fees, and features of your plan with thirty (30) days' notice. If a change increases your monthly plan price, you may cancel without paying the early termination fee, but the remaining device balance still becomes due.
clauses.title: They can change terms
clauses.meaning: Nimbus Mobile can change your plan's price, fees, or features with 30 days' notice. If they raise your plan price, you can cancel without the $200 early termination fee, but you still owe the rest of your phone's cost.
clauses.whyItMatters: Your plan terms are not fully fixed. If Nimbus Mobile raises your plan price, you can leave without the $200 penalty, but you still have to pay for your phone immediately.
clauses.whatToDo: Understand that your monthly costs could increase beyond the scheduled price jump. If they do, you can leave, but you will still have to pay for the phone.

clauses.quote: You may cancel and return the device in like-new condition within fourteen (14) days of purchase for a full refund of the device price and plan charges, less usage charges.
clauses.title: 14-day return window
clauses.meaning: You have 14 days to return the phone and cancel service for a full refund, as long as the phone is like new. You will still pay for any service you used.
clauses.whyItMatters: This gives you a short period to test the service and device. If it doesn't work for you, you can get most of your money back.
clauses.whatToDo: Test the service thoroughly in the first 14 days. If you are not satisfied, return the device promptly.

clauses.quote: You and Nimbus agree to resolve disputes through binding individual arbitration instead of in court, except for small-claims matters.
clauses.title: No court, only arbitration
clauses.meaning: You cannot sue Nimbus Mobile in court for most disputes. You must use an arbitrator, and you cannot join a class-action lawsuit.
clauses.whyItMatters: Arbitration can be faster than court, but it limits your legal options. You give up your right to a jury trial and to participate in group lawsuits.
clauses.whatToDo: Be aware that your options for resolving serious disputes are limited to arbitration.

terms.plain: This is the first 12 months of your contract, when your plan price is $35 per month.
This is a $5 monthly discount you get for setting up automatic payments and paperless billing.
This is a $3.49 monthly fee Nimbus Mobile charges, which is not a tax and can change.
This is the total amount you still owe on your phone if you cancel early.
This means disputes are settled by a neutral third party, not in court, and you cannot join with other customers.
